metadata.question: Was the area burned in Canada from Jan to August 3, 2025 greater than the area burned by the same period in 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS burned area product (MCD64A1) or FIRMS active fire data - Compare two periods: Jan 1 - Aug 3, 2023 vs Jan 1 - Aug 3, 2025 - Location: Canada boundary (can use FAO GAUL or define approximate bounds) - MCD64A1 has monthly burn date band - need to sum burned area 2. Masking strategy: - For MCD64A1, pixels with BurnDate > 0 indicate burned areas - Need to filter by day-of-year to only include burns up to Aug 3 (day 215) - Sum total burned pixels for each period 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Zero burned area is valid (B answer: 2025 not greater than 2023) - Check collection size for both periods - Verify pixel counts are valid numbers - Compare: if 2025 burned area > 2023 burned area → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Canada geometry (approximate bounding box) const canada = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-141, 42, -52, 84]); // Day of year for August 3 is 215 (non-leap) or 216 (leap year) const dayOfYear2023 = 215; // 2023 is not a leap year const dayOfYear2025 = 215; // 2025 is not a leap year // Get MODIS Burned Area for 2023 (Jan-Aug) const burned2023 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD64A1') .filterDate('2023-01-01', '2023-08-04') .filterBounds(canada) .select('BurnDate'); const size2023 = burned2023.size().getInfo(); console.log('2023 Images:', size2023); if (size2023 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2023 period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get MODIS Burned Area for 2025 (Jan-Aug) const burned2025 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD64A1') .filterDate('2025-01-01', '2025-08-04') .filterBounds(canada); const size2025 = burned2025.size().getInfo(); console.log('2025 Images:', size2025); if (size2025 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2025 period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Process 2023: mask for burns before Aug 3, count pixels const burned2023Mosaic = burned2023.mosaic(); const mask2023 = burned2023Mosaic.gt(0).and(burned2023Mosaic.lte(dayOfYear2023)); const area2023 = mask2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: canada, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate'); const area2023Val = area2023.getInfo(); // Process 2025: mask for burns before Aug 3, count pixels const burned2025Mosaic = burned2025.mosaic(); const mask2025 = burned2025Mosaic.gt(0).and(burned2025Mosaic.lte(dayOfYear2025)); const area2025 = mask2025.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: canada, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate'); const area2025Val = area2025.getInfo(); console.log('2023 Burned pixels:', area2023Val); console.log('2025 Burned pixels:', area2025Val); // Validate results if (area2023Val === null || area2025Val === null || isNaN(area2023Val) || isNaN(area2025Val)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare areas if (area2025Val > area2023Val) { console.log('2025 burned area greater than 2023.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('2025 burned area NOT greater than 2023.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
